info.title: Business Partner API
info.description:
A business workspace: a partner that learns the business from the owner and its documents, a searchable knowledge index, role assistants, and connectors they act through.

Answers and actions come from language models working on your documents: decision support, not legal, tax or financial advice. Check them against the source before relying on them. See DISCLAIMER.md.

post.summary: Add a document to the library
post.description:
Store a file: the original (for page rendering and download) and its
searchable passages. PDFs and images are read page by page (OCR where
there is no text layer); text files by section, paragraph or row. SSNs
are masked in the passages. The same file uploaded again returns the
stored document with 200 instead of 201.

post.summary: Ask the assistant about stored documents
post.description:
Stateless: send the conversation so far, oldest first, ending with the
user's message. The assistant uses read-only tools (search, browse, read
and list documents) on the documents this key may read, within `scope`,
then answers citing excerpts as [n].
`sources` lists every excerpt it retrieved under those numbers;
`tool_calls` lists the tools it ran. The workspace's own records
(business profile, discovery answers, notes) are part of what it searches.

AssistantSpec.title: AssistantSpec
AssistantSpec.description:
An assistant is this JSON object. The partner creates them; the owner can write or edit one by hand.

{"name": "Accountant", "role": "Keeps the books and prepares the monthly report",
 "department": "Finance", "instructions": "...", "connectors": ["<connector id>"],
 "knowledge": {"departments": ["Finance"]}, "shares": ["finance", "month-end"],
 "policy": {"default": "ask", "tools": {"<connector id>/list_invoices": "auto"}}}
